phases.title: Put the finished work live
phases.desc: Phases 1–5 run locally; these steps switch them on for real. Mostly yours: Claude prepares each step.

phases.title: Check it on the real site
phases.desc: Short checks after the deploy, a few minutes each. Claude writes the steps; you tap through them.

phases.title: Put in your real data
phases.desc: Replace the examples with what you actually pay for, so reminders and totals mean something.

phases.title: Clean out the old leftovers
phases.desc: Small, safe removals of things copied from the starter project. One commit each.

phases.title: Make it sturdy
phases.desc: Keep it working as it changes: tests in the repo, checks on every push, nothing lost.

phases.title: Make daily use easier
phases.desc: Improvements for everyday use, best done after a few weeks with real data.

phases.title: Link the vault
phases.desc: Fix the vault's security holes in its own repo, then show its key-rotation dates here.

tasks.title: Set Supabase site and redirect URLs
tasks.detail: Authentication → URL Configuration: site https://saas-boss-v20.vercel.app, redirect …/auth/callback.

tasks.title: Run migration 0002 (security)
tasks.detail: SQL Editor: run supabase/migrations/0002_security.sql; it must come before two-factor login.

tasks.title: Run migration 0003 (cards and receipts)
tasks.detail: Adds cards, payments, receipts and the private receipts file bucket.

tasks.title: Run migration 0004 (expiry checks)
tasks.detail: Adds the fields for automatic domain and SSL checks.

tasks.title: Run migration 0005 (live updates)
tasks.detail: Lets the open app hear changes from the bot, the hourly job and other devices.

tasks.title: Set CRON_SECRET and app URL in Vercel
tasks.detail: Add CRON_SECRET (a long random string) and NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL, then redeploy.

tasks.title: Merge the local fixes into main
tasks.detail: Claude opens a pull request for branch local-qa-fixes (10 fixes from local testing); you merge it and Vercel deploys.

tasks.title: Create the hourly cron-job.org job
tasks.detail: GET /api/cron/reminders every hour with the header Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>.

tasks.title: Create the Telegram bot
tasks.detail: @BotFather → new bot; put TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET in Vercel and redeploy.

tasks.title: Connect Telegram from Settings
tasks.detail: Settings → Telegram reminders → Set up bot → Connect Telegram, then send /start.

tasks.title: Turn on two-factor login
tasks.detail: Settings → Security: add your authenticator app; from then on your data needs the code.

tasks.title: Turn off public sign-ups
tasks.detail: Supabase → Authentication: turn off 'Allow new users to sign up' now that your account exists.

tasks.title: Add the backup secrets in GitHub
tasks.detail: SUPABASE_DB_URL (Session pooler) and BACKUP_PASSPHRASE, then run Nightly database backup once.

tasks.title: Add the Claude API key for receipts
tasks.detail: Optional: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in Vercel lets photo and PDF receipts be read; redeploy after.

tasks.title: Decide whether to make the repo private
tasks.detail: Backups are encrypted, but a private repo also hides the code and commit history.

tasks.title: Sign in with password and 2FA code
tasks.detail: The live sign-in asks for the authenticator code and shows your data after it.

tasks.title: Lock and unlock with a passkey
tasks.detail: Settings → App lock on your phone; the app locks when idle and opens with your fingerprint or face.

tasks.title: Check the hourly job succeeds
tasks.detail: cron-job.org history shows 200 responses for a few hours in a row.

tasks.title: Send a test reminder to Telegram
tasks.detail: Settings → Send test reminder arrives in Telegram with its buttons.

tasks.title: Mark a reminder paid from Telegram
tasks.detail: Tap ✅ Paid on a reminder; the payment shows up in the open app without reloading.

tasks.title: Send a receipt photo to the bot
tasks.detail: The bot replies with what it read; confirm it and find it in Receipts.

tasks.title: Paste an emailed receipt to the bot
tasks.detail: Forward or paste the email text and check the vendor, amount and date.

tasks.title: Try /due and /month in Telegram
tasks.detail: Both commands answer with this month's renewals and spending.

tasks.title: Check one real domain's expiry
tasks.detail: Set the check target on a domain date, press Check now and compare with the registrar.

tasks.title: Check one real site's SSL date
tasks.detail: Same for an SSL date; compare with the certificate the browser shows.

tasks.title: See changes sync between two devices
tasks.detail: Edit a service on the laptop and watch it change on the phone.

tasks.title: Confirm the exchange rate updates daily
tasks.detail: The USD → ETB rate and its date in Settings change after the next day.

tasks.title: Confirm the first nightly backup
tasks.detail: GitHub Actions → Nightly database backup is green and the encrypted file is there.

tasks.title: Practise restoring a backup once
tasks.detail: Follow README → Restore into a local copy on your computer, so you know it works.

tasks.title: Check sign-in alerts and the security log
tasks.detail: A new sign-in appears in Security activity and sends a Telegram alert.

tasks.title: Check the phone layout on the live site
tasks.detail: Dashboard, Cards & Payments and Receipts fit the screen without sideways scrolling.

tasks.title: Create one product per app
tasks.detail: Each SaaS app you run becomes a product with its name and URL.

tasks.title: Import from your spreadsheet, if any
tasks.detail: If your list lives in a spreadsheet, Claude turns it into the CSV import format.

tasks.title: Add every paid service
tasks.detail: Hosting, database, email, AI and other services with price, cycle and next renewal.

tasks.title: Add your domains with expiry dates
tasks.detail: One date per domain, with the domain as its check target.

tasks.title: Add hand-renewed SSL certificates
tasks.detail: Only ones you renew yourself; Vercel and Cloudflare certificates renew on their own.

tasks.title: Add API keys and their rotation dates
tasks.detail: Names and dates only; the keys themselves stay in the vault.

tasks.title: Add your cards and the friend
tasks.detail: Cards & Payments: each virtual card (last 4 digits, expiry) and the friend in the USA.

tasks.title: Set each card's current balance
tasks.detail: So the top-up planner and low-balance alerts start right.

tasks.title: Record this month's payments so far
tasks.detail: So the summary on the 1st has real numbers.

tasks.title: Send this month's receipts to the bot
tasks.detail: Photos, PDFs or email text; match each one to its payment.

tasks.title: Choose reminder days and digest time
tasks.detail: Settings → Reminders: days before (for example 14, 7, 3, 1) and the hour of the daily digest.

tasks.title: Turn on auto checks where wanted
tasks.detail: Auto check on the domain and SSL dates you want verified every day.

tasks.title: Review the totals together
tasks.detail: Claude compares the USD and birr totals with your own numbers to spot anything missing.

tasks.title: Remove the Android Studio guide
tasks.detail: Delete AndroidInstallGuideModal, the header Android button and its command palette entry.
tasks.note: Local only (branch local-qa-fixes, not deployed), commit 56b289f. Guide deleted with its header button, sidebar item and command palette entry; the header's install-app button stays. Local browser tests and GitHub checks green.

tasks.title: Remove the FREE plan badge
tasks.detail: The sidebar shows a workspace plan; a single-user app has no plans.
tasks.note: Local only, commit 661ef40. Badge gone from the sidebar and Settings; the phone header says "Totals in USD" instead of "free plan • USD".

tasks.title: Drop the plan field from workspaces
tasks.detail: Remove 'free' | 'pro' from the app's types and seed data; leave the database column alone.
tasks.note: Local only, commit 5844315. Removed from the Workspace type, demo data and new workspaces. The database column stays (default 'free'), so no migration needed.

tasks.title: Remove the vault sync stub
tasks.detail: Delete VaultSyncModal and the 'Vault Sync Stub' until the real link in phase 7.
tasks.note: Local only (branch local-qa-fixes, not deployed), commit 79e3741. The window's Sync Now only added one made-up date. Removed it with its header button, sidebar item, command palette entry and Settings link; the dashboard's Sanitize Secrets now opens Services. Kept: vault references on services and the secret warning. GitHub checks green.

tasks.title: Stop the fake vault.internal.net default
tasks.detail: New workspaces get a made-up vault URL; leave it empty instead.
tasks.note: Local only, commit c7f53e1. New workspaces start with no vault address; the old made-up one counts as not set, so no database change. Vault references show as labels until you set your vault's address in Settings, then open the key. New unit and browser tests; GitHub checks green.

tasks.title: Call them Services everywhere
tasks.detail: Replace 'Service Links' in the sidebar, headings and product page with 'Services'.
tasks.note: Local only (branch local-qa-fixes, not deployed), commit c3411e3. "Service Links" is now "Services" in the menu, page titles, form and buttons, product page, search, bulk edit, clone, templates, import/export, onboarding and the audit log. Database names unchanged. GitHub checks green.

tasks.title: Show seed-data restore only in demo
tasks.detail: 'Restore Deterministic Seed Data' in Settings belongs to demo mode only.
tasks.note: Local only, commit 2b8ba78. Now "Restore the demo data", shown only in demo mode (it never touched live data, but looked like it could). A browser test checks it's absent from the live workspace. GitHub checks green.

tasks.title: Decide on the Telegram simulator
tasks.detail: Keep it if it previews the real messages exactly; otherwise remove it.

tasks.title: Match product templates to a real stack
tasks.detail: Templates list Clerk, Stripe and others; base them on services a solo founder really uses.

tasks.title: Delete files nothing uses
tasks.detail: Run a dead-code check and remove unused components, helpers and exports.

tasks.title: Remove unused npm packages
tasks.detail: Check each dependency is imported somewhere; drop the rest.

tasks.title: One wording pass over every page
tasks.detail: Fix leftover names, typos and words from the starter project.

tasks.title: Bring the README up to date
tasks.detail: Drop removed features and keep one clear path for first setup.

tasks.title: Save the QA scripts as repo tests
tasks.detail: Move the Playwright flows from the scratch folder into tests/e2e so they outlive this session.
tasks.note: Local only (branch local-qa-fixes, not deployed), commit 744c281. 35 Playwright tests in tests/e2e replace the scratch QA scripts and fail on a wrong result instead of printing it. Not carried over: the 60-second-token test (needs a temporary login setting) and the old fake-database scripts (the real local stack replaced them).

tasks.title: One command to run the e2e tests
tasks.detail: npm run test:e2e uses the local Docker stack on its own ports.
tasks.note: Local only, commit 744c281. npm run test:e2e with the local stack running and npm run dev:local stopped; first time also npx playwright install chromium. About 3.5 minutes; 35 of 35 passed twice in a row. Steps in README → End-to-end tests.

tasks.title: Run tests and type check on each push
tasks.detail: A GitHub Actions workflow for npm test and npm run lint.
tasks.note: On GitHub for branch local-qa-fixes (main gets it when merged), commit 4b87f82. Workflow "Checks" runs on every push and pull request; docs-only pushes are skipped. First run green: type check + 114 unit tests in 31 s.

tasks.title: Check the build on pull requests
tasks.detail: next build in CI so a broken deploy is caught before merging.
tasks.note: On GitHub, commit 4b87f82. Production build job (no settings needed) on every push and pull request; first run green in 34 s.

tasks.title: Run the e2e tests in CI
tasks.detail: Start the local Supabase in GitHub Actions and run the flows on pull requests.
tasks.note: On GitHub, commit 4b87f82. The runner starts the local Supabase in Docker and runs all 35 browser tests on every push and pull request; first run: 35 of 35, none retried, 4.5 min. Failed runs keep screenshots for a week (Artifacts).

tasks.title: Turn on Dependabot and npm audit
tasks.detail: Weekly dependency updates and a security audit in CI.

tasks.title: Back up receipt files too
tasks.detail: The nightly backup covers the database only; add the receipt files, encrypted (needs one more GitHub secret).

tasks.title: Test backup and restore in CI
tasks.detail: Back up a test database, restore it into a fresh one and compare row counts.

tasks.title: Add a status panel in Settings
tasks.detail: Last hourly run, last backup, Telegram webhook state and last rate update in one place.

tasks.title: Warn when the hourly job stops
tasks.detail: If reminders haven't run for 3 hours, show a banner in the app.

tasks.title: Show the last failed Telegram send
tasks.detail: Settings shows when and why a message failed, and that email was used instead.

tasks.title: Limit request rates on public routes
tasks.detail: Cap the webhook, receipt reading and sign-in helper routes per address.

tasks.title: Check the live security headers
tasks.detail: Fetch the live site's headers and fix anything looser than the local copy.

tasks.title: Keep a short changelog
tasks.detail: A CHANGELOG.md entry per merge, in plain words.

tasks.title: Fix sideways scroll on phone payments
tasks.detail: Found by the new phone-layout test: Cards & Payments was 585px wide on a 375px screen once payments were listed.
tasks.note: Local only, commit 2a53c9b. The table's hidden Delete column heading escaped its scroll box; the box now holds it.

tasks.title: Warn about services on an expiring card
tasks.detail: When a card is near expiry, list the services that charge it.

tasks.title: Free-trial end reminders
tasks.detail: A trial flag with an end date and a reminder 3 days before it bills.

tasks.title: Flag price changes
tasks.detail: Warn when a payment's amount differs from the service's listed price.

tasks.title: Ask about unused services each quarter
tasks.detail: A Telegram question per service: still using it? Keep or Cancel.

tasks.title: Monthly budget per product
tasks.detail: Set a budget and get a Telegram alert at 80% and 100%.

tasks.title: Yearly cost per product
tasks.detail: Cost per product per year in USD and birr, with the trend.

tasks.title: Export a month as CSV or PDF
tasks.detail: Payments and receipts for one month, for your records or taxes.

tasks.title: Add a service from Telegram
tasks.detail: /add Vercel Pro 20 USD monthly creates it in the chosen product.

tasks.title: Weekly digest option
tasks.detail: A Monday summary of the week's renewals instead of a daily one.

tasks.title: Receipts by email forwarding
tasks.detail: A forwarding address for emailed receipts (needs a domain and an inbound email service).

tasks.title: Helpful empty pages for a new account
tasks.detail: Each empty page says what to add first and has the button for it.

tasks.title: Contrast check in both themes
tasks.detail: Every page and dialog readable in light and dark.

tasks.title: Pick the next improvements together
tasks.detail: After a month of real use, choose what to build next and add it here.

tasks.title: Add the vault repo to this session
tasks.detail: Claude needs read and push access to the vault's repository.

tasks.title: Security review of the vault
tasks.detail: List each hole (unlock fall-through, readable device storage, headers, login) with its fix.

tasks.title: Fix the vault unlock fall-through
tasks.detail: Unlocking must fail closed when the fingerprint or face check fails.

tasks.title: No readable secrets on the device
tasks.detail: Nothing decrypted left in browser storage, the same rule as StackTrack.

tasks.title: Security headers for the vault
tasks.detail: The same strict content policy and headers StackTrack uses.

tasks.title: Two-factor login for the vault
tasks.detail: Authenticator code required, enforced by the database rules.

tasks.title: Agree what the vault shares
tasks.detail: Key names and rotation dates only, never the secrets; you approve the format.

tasks.title: Build the vault → StackTrack sync
tasks.detail: A signed, read-only feed of key names and dates that StackTrack pulls each day.

tasks.title: Show vault keys as dates
tasks.detail: Synced keys appear in Dates with rotation reminders, marked as from the vault.

tasks.title: Replace the stub with real vault settings
tasks.detail: Settings → Vault: connect, last sync, and disconnect.

tasks.title: Test the vault link end to end
tasks.detail: Rotate a test key in the vault and see the new date in StackTrack.
